name: Sun Cleric: a Vow procs once when the Sun Cleric heals itself
contract: Vow of Radiance 803489 reads 'Direct ability damage or healing generates 2 Solar Power and damages or heals for an additional 25% of the amount.' Vow of Light 807547 reads 'Direct damage taken or direct healing taken by you generates 1 Solar Power and heals the nearest nearby ally equal to 9% of the amount.' One heal is one event, so it generates the Solar Power once whoever its target is. Solar Power is the 500149 caster aura (StackAmount 20). Illumination 500143 is a direct SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on an ally (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY), which the Sun Cleric may aim at itself. Unit::TriggerAurasProcOnEvent evaluates the actor's auras with the done flags (PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_POS for this heal) and then the action target's auras with the taken flags (PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_POS); on a self-heal both passes read the same aura. The Vow spell_proc rows from rev_20260909_13_sun_cleric_completion.sql carry ProcFlags 1048575, every done and taken flag, and aura_ascension_sun_cleric_event accepts both passes (the heal's actor is the Sun Cleric in both, and for Vow of Light so is its action target), so a self-heal ran each Vow twice. Expected: a self-heal under Vow of Radiance leaves exactly 2 Solar Power and a following heal on an ally adds exactly 2 more; under Vow of Light a self-heal leaves exactly 1 and a heal received from another Sun Cleric adds exactly 1 more.

steps.label: Let login settle
Take Vow of Radiance
Take Vow of Light
SETUP: Vow of Radiance is active
SETUP: Vow of Light is active
Let the Vows' global cooldown expire
BASELINE: no Solar Power on the Vow of Radiance cleric
BASELINE: no Solar Power on the Vow of Light cleric
Leave room for an effective self-heal
Vow of Radiance: heal yourself
SETUP: the self-heal lands
Let every proc of that heal resolve
DISCRIMINATING: one self-heal under Vow of Radiance generates 2 Solar Power, not 4
Let the global cooldown expire
Leave room for an effective heal on the ally
Vow of Radiance: heal an ally
SETUP: the ally heal lands
Let every proc of that heal resolve
CONTROL: a heal on an ally still generates 2 Solar Power
Leave room for an effective self-heal
Vow of Light: heal yourself
SETUP: the self-heal lands
Let every proc of that heal resolve
DISCRIMINATING: one self-heal under Vow of Light generates 1 Solar Power, not 2
Leave room for an effective received heal
Another Sun Cleric heals the Vow of Light cleric
SETUP: the received heal lands
Let every proc of that heal resolve
CONTROL: healing received from another still generates 1 Solar Power
